Let a trime be defined as a three-digit integer for which any two digits of the 
integer, ordered as they appear in the original integer, form a two-digit prime 
number. For example, 137 is a trime because 13, 17 and 37 are all prime 
numbers. However, 211 is not a trime because 21 is not prime. What is the 
greatest trime?
